transport: ChatGPT GitHub app writes requests/command.json; GitHub Actions executes and commits results/<request_id>.json
routing_boundary: Only Design-owned controlled-runtime evidence is selectable here. SEO, Elementor, Leads, Website QA and Programmeren use their own owner repositories and contracts.

routes.trigger_when: Design owns the task and rendered-page evidence can materially change the design decision, risk or acceptance.
routes.do_not_trigger_when: Pure strategy/briefing without runtime evidence, explicit Figma/Canva/Product Design/ImageGen output, implementation-only work or independent QA-only acceptance.
routes.why: Collect bounded rendered-page evidence for the Design owner without transferring design ownership.

routes.trigger_when: Before redesign, cleanup, before/after comparison, design-engineering handoff or a claim that requires a reproducible visual baseline.
routes.do_not_trigger_when: No mutation/comparison/claim is planned or a current valid baseline already covers the exact artifact, version, route, state and viewport scope.
routes.why: Create reproducible desktop/tablet/mobile controlled-runtime screenshots before change.

routes.trigger_when: A before/after or regression comparison is required and two same-dimension screenshots are available from persisted Design evidence.
routes.do_not_trigger_when: There is no comparable baseline, dimensions differ by design, or visual change alone cannot answer the user question.
routes.why: Quantify candidate visual change from persisted evidence; Design still decides whether the change is intended or better.

routes.trigger_when: Design owns an accessibility-sensitive component/page decision and automated risk signals can change the design decision or acceptance criteria.
routes.do_not_trigger_when: The request is a formal WCAG conformance claim or independent browser/AT acceptance; route that acceptance to Website QA.
routes.why: Find automated accessibility risks as controlled-runtime support evidence, never as a conformance claim.
